subject: Reference & use-case matchmaking for US Catalyst telemedicine procurement

From: Marta Ruiz <marta@uscatalysthealth.com>
To: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, procurement@uscatalysthealth.com
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Reference requests for telemedicine vendor shortlist

Hi Sean,

We're in the final stages of evaluating telemedicine vendors for an enterprise procurement (pilot across 120 clinics). Procurement has asked for two customer references that can speak specifically to:
- operationalizing a private deployment behind our VPC,
- latency and throughput during concurrent clinician sessions, and
- security/compliance posture for audit (SOC2 + custom retention controls).

Can you match us with two customers that:
1) are US-based health systems (preferably mid-sized or larger), and
2) have run a telemedicine pilot that included clinician-facing integrations (EHR single-sign-on / scheduling).

We need reference calls next week for a late-stage procurement committee. Also flag if there are NDA/MPA steps we should complete in advance.

Thanks — feel free to loop in anyone on your side who manages customer advocacy.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Senior Procurement Manager
US Catalyst Health
marta@uscatalysthealth.com

- We have two excellent references that match your criteria:
  * DrChron Care Network (mid-sized health system, ran a 12-week pilot across ambulatory clinics; did a VPC private deployment for PHI; contact: Elise Morgan)
  * Meridian Health Partners (regional system; integrated with Epic for SSO and scheduling; contact: Omar Vazquez)

Vanessa — I attached a short advocate_profiles_USC.pdf with one-paragraph summaries and availability windows. We also have a stub MPA that the legal team can sign quickly if needed (attached).

Marta — if you can confirm two 30-minute windows next week (and whether you prefer clinician + procurement or just procurement + technical), Vanessa will propose exact times and send calendar invites. Also let us know if you require a mutual NDA in advance — happy to route ours or sign yours; I attached our standard NDA template for speed.

Thanks — I’ll keep the deal team aligned (deal id: USCH-2026-1192).

Hi Marta — happy to coordinate. Quick advocate notes and proposed cadence below.

Advocates we recommend (short bullets pulled from attached profiles):
- Elise Morgan — Director of Digital Health, DrChron Care Network
  * Pilot size: 75 clinicians, hybrid private deployment + hosted fallback; key win: consistent 95th %-tile latency under 200ms in production.
  * Can speak to SOC2 audit prep and custom retention controls.
- Omar Vazquez — VP IT, Meridian Health Partners
  * Pilot size: 120 clinicians, Epic integration for SSO, automated scheduling sync.
  * Can speak to deployment orchestration and clinician workflow adoption.

Scheduling options (all times in ET):
- Tues, Jul 28 — 11:00–11:30 or 14:00–14:30
- Wed, Jul 29 — 10:00–10:30 or 16:00–16:30

We recommend two separate 30-minute calls: 1) tech + procurement with Omar, 2) operations + compliance with Elise. If a single combined session is preferred we can do a 45-minute slot.

I've attached advocate_profiles_USC.pdf (bios + talking points). If you need signed paperwork before the call, we can fast-track the MPA and NDA — Priyom, can you confirm whether the advocates need any special prep materials or if we should share a 1-page agenda?
